item.title: The Candy Cane
item.description: Sounds a little corny but I had this idea since Thanksgiving so I decided to try it out.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror and History

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: The SCP I envisioned is a plastic candy cane filled with small M&M-like candies that have different outcomes to it. While one candy that was eaten will give a person something like a lost possession or make them feel happy another could have immense tragedy or have the person who ate it either die or vanish through a trans dimensional entry way or property while a small select few saying that they are speaking for the candy cane.

Central Narrative: The story is mainly about how the candies affected history and while they test the object it shows some form of sentience and claims to have caused some of the worst tragedies and triumphs in history and saying that they had been the first thing consumed and will be the last thing consumed by man.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This is just an idea that I had and wanted to share. While some SCP’s are intriguing for their gruesome nature and such I think an SCP that is more based on luck and a way to solve some of the worlds greater mysteries and why certain things happened would be a intriguing idea.

Additional Notes: I just have a problem of answering a genre. However, I am pretty confident in this even with a hiccup in that department. I will except all the feedback I can get because this one I want to see through till the end and make this my first SCP entry.

item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) The Bartender
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Drama

Elevator Pitch: A humanoid SCP that is approximately from 6 to 15 feet tall, dressed up in a bartender suit of the mid-1900s, and has its general appearance as a tall black figure that has devoid facial features, and no sign of hair, nose, eyes, has unchecked limitations, and numerous of anomalous abilities. In all of which, it is in foundation custody. The Foundation's goal was to prevent its anomalous abilities from attempting to cause out an event of containment breaches by accident. The containment procedure was to keep SCP-XXXX inside a 16 x 60 ft (about 3.7 x 5.5m) room constructed out of tungsten.

Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX is a humanoid entity dressed up in a bartender suit of the mid-1900s, comprised of a white shirt, a black or red tie, black trousers, and black shoes. It measures 6 to 15 feet tall has a general appearance as a tall black figure. However, it is possible that this is not SCP-XXXX's true form and that it is an eldritch being that cannot comprehend whose proper form. Its face is pitch black, utterly devoid of facial features. However, despite lacking facial features, SCP-XXXX can sense when its targets are near at all times, as it never hesitates and always sees the targets around it. SCP-XXXX has various anomalous abilities that the Foundation was to yet discovered. The ones learned so far are based on the logs of the incident, description, experiments, and interviewing logs of the Foundation, which are:

+ show block
– hide block
  • Teleportation.
  • Mind-affecting.
  • Memory adding, erasing, and inhibiting.
  • Causing instant death by making eye contact with a subject longer than three (3) seconds.
  • Extremely high superhuman attributes.
  • Causing out technological disruption upon technologies in random times without wanting it to do so.
  • Able to sense how dangerous the ones it confronts are.
  • Cause out phenomenons to become omnipresent and warp space and time between locations.
  • Strong regenerative healing factor.
  • SCP-XXXX's skin causes out common diseases that could lead to the death of those who touch it.
  • Able to sprout out tendrils that're sustainable towards all harmful things in any place of its body.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The idea of having an SCP that has various extremely dangerous and powerful anomalous abilities.

Additional Notes: I couldn't figure it out. People said that my grammar was having problems, but I've fixed my grammar errors and even improved my SCP article. What am I really missing?

item.title: First Time Author looking for review
item.description: essentially a voodoo doll, but bear with me, there's a twist
item.content:encoded:
At first glance it might seem boring, my idea is essentially a voodoo doll, but bear with me, there's a twist that I think is unique enough to give this a chance. I've been reading SCPs for years and I've always wanted to write my own but I usually scrap them because I don't think they're good enough, so I'm really excited to share this :)

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up a lot of space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: voodoo doll that when picked up, causes the subject to fly into rage against the last person to anger them, the voodoo doll will take on the appearance of that person, and the subject will use it to kill the victim by any means available. These people are now known as SCP-XXX-1(Subject) and -2(victim). When the victim is killed, the doll reverts to its original form and repairs all damage, the subject will then lose their memory of interacting with the doll. After event XXX-01, it is discovered that the doll has a cognitohazard effect that makes people want to use it.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: In an addendum, event XXX-01 is described, along with an interrogation log and security tape transcript, where a guard unknowingly uses the scp to kill his boss while patrolling the anomalous item vault the object was contained in. It is investigated and found that the SCP has developed a new property while in containment, the O5 council releases a statement acknowledging the threat posed by this and suggests the development of an Emergent Properties Research Division (EPRD), in order to study the possible ‘evolution’ of anomalous properties in contained SCPs. The SCP is reclassified from safe to euclid, and containment protocols are updated

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The main hook here is the emergent properties idea. I don’t think I’ve ever read an article that mentions SCPs ‘evolving’ new anomalous properties, and I explain it in the article as an adaptation made by the SCP in order to affect people while still in containment. I think it’s just a cool new thing to add to the lore, as well as creating a new branch of the foundation in the EPRD

Additional Notes: As mentioned in the title, I am a first time writer, so all criticism is welcome. I’ve been reading SCPs for years so I think I have a grasp on how to write them, but we’ll see how this is received. I have the full article written in my sandbox if you’d like to just read it.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: The Stalker (Looking for Green Light)
item.description: A SCP that is always around a present
item.content:encoded:
A SCP that is always around a present, first you just saw it once at work, now no matter where you are it is always there.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Emotional

Elevator Pitch: The idea is a SCP that slowly creeps into the victim's life. At first he’s a random face in the street, not unlike the hundreds of unknown faces you pass everyday. But over time he's just there more often, now he's at the commissary, at your favorite restaurant, and you swear you saw him through your front window. Wait was he that person you just saw out the corner of your eye? This process then repeats but quicker with hearing him everywhere and then even quicker with feeling his presence everywhere. After this it seems he's not only around you at all times, but now he's in your head. Every moment, every thought he's there.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: The SCP article will be told through a series of interviews and documents. The central story is a chronological story told by a series of interviews and other documents. It starts with a victim recounting his story as defined in the hook below, and then followed by his missing papers. This man is the first known victim of the SCP and causes the SCP foundation to launch an operation into the man's town to try and find the SCP (told through a OPORD). While they do find the SCP it escapes by unknown means but one of the SCP agents gets infected by the SCP and is put into quarantine. After a month in quarantine being a SCP scientist checking on the Agent is infected and the Agent seemingly disappeared. The infected scientist escapes to the original victim's town, the rest of the story is finding why the SCP is attracted to here.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The hook will be an interview between a SCP Scientist and a SCP victim. In the interview the victim, clearly traumatized by what's happening to him, recounts his story of how the SCP is everywhere. It's basically the elevator pitch in more detail. I put a *rough* draft for this interview below if yall want to see how this will look in execution.

Additional Notes: I'm not sure if this is similar to any other SCP, please tell me if it is. Note the final step after the SCP is always present in the victim's mind is eventually the victim becomes the SCP, still the same person, but now that person is the SCP.

Hook Rough Draft

Rough draft, I know this doesn't follow SCP Interview Protocols, will fix it in actual.
“I don't know who he is, no, I can’t even tell what he is. Everytime I go out he’s there, he’s a waiter, a random face in a crowd, or even my own co-worker, but no matter what he’s always there. It just doesn't make sense, he can’t physically be everywhere, no it's definitely impossible, it's unnatural. How can a single man be everywhere? Even when I'm in the safety of my own home… What cruel joke do I mean by saying safety, I hear his goddamn voice there too! Whether i’m eating or sleeping, his voice is just there. At first it was just another random voice I heard at work, you know one of those hundreds of random background voices you hear every day, but then I started hearing it more and more. Now *sob*, now it's all I can hear, for the love of god I don’t want to hear that wretched thing anymore. Even now, I see it, I hear it, … my god, it's here, I can feel it. *addressing SCP Scientist* Why, why is it here, you told me I would be safe here, but it's here. I know it's here, I can feel it! *standing up*Come out demon, where are you hiding!! *falling to the floor* Please, please just leave me alone.”


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts, and be mindful of the wordcount limit noted in the required reading. ~Zyn

item.title: Seeking Greenlight: Fireproof SAR Dog
item.description: I’m looking for a greenlight for my SCP article idea.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Dramatic, Lighthearted

Elevator Pitch: This SCP would be a SAR (Search and Rescue) dog that is completely unaffected by fire and smoke. The dog is also able to control small flames. Other than that, the dog is a completely average dalmatian.

Central Narrative: The narrative of this SCP article would be the discovery of this animal’s anomalous properties, descriptions of various SAR missions the dog was used on, and how the dog came to be contained by the Foundation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The dog was the mascot of a fire station until it’s owners discovered its anomalous properties. It was subsequently trained as a SAR dog until it was contained by the Foundation. Presumably, given this SCP’s ability, prior training, and the ease of containment/control, the Foundation could potentially utilize this SCP for its own SAR missions during small incidents (i.e. fires, earthquakes) or even in assistance with small-scale breaches.

Additional Notes: I’m open to any critiques or suggestions. My plan is to make this article fairly straightforward and short given that this is my first. I’ve volunteered with SAR work and SAR dogs in the past so I wouldn’t need to conduct too much research.

item.title: Malicious Magnet (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
A floating, anomalous magnetic object that works like a normal magnet, except it has the ability to cause as much harm to humans as possible.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Similar to a standard SCP article, having 4 additional addendums that show testing logs.

Elevator Pitch: A floating, inanimate, red metal object that exhibits an anomalous magnetic force. It will work as a normal magnet when presented with most metal objects. However, it will alter its magnetic force when humans are around, causing pain (due to altering blood flow) or even death to individuals with things like pacemakers or prosthetic replacements. It will also destroy any technology that comes close enough using this force.

Central Narrative: The SCP was originally found in a meteoroid crash site. The anomaly was originally reported to the foundation because of the death of 3 individuals investigating the meteorite. It was relatively difficult to retrieve because it had torn the body armor of the MTF sent to investigate, causing major injuries to the chest area. It was eventually retrieved aircraft, towing it to containment through a long-distance hook.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think this SCP has the potential for a lot of interesting testing and theorizing, and I don't think a sentient magnet concept has been done before.

Additional Notes: It is unknown if this SCP is sentient or not.

item.title: Alternate dimension where man-made flight is nearly impossible
item.description: This dimension is almost exactly the same as ours
item.content:encoded:
This dimension is almost exactly the same as ours, except humans cannot go above a certain height limit in the atmosphere without going insane or catatonic.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Science Fiction, Religion

Page Layout: There will be a series of interviews, documenting what the alternate universe is like, followed by an addendum showing how certain historical events have changed due to airplanes not being in wide use, and a final addendum that reveals its a world where God has deemed that humans are not allowed to leave the planet.

Elevator Pitch: This is an alternate dimension where man-made flight is essentially impossible, due to a phenomenon that occurs above a certain altitude (current thinking is about 6km up) that makes piloting and generally thinking rationally impossible.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: The story will show how the Foundations of both universes try to work together to discover the cause of the anomaly, as well as discover the differences in each other's histories.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Much of the history of the 20th's century was shaped by the advent of air power. But what if air power was never a thing? Air craft carriers, strategic bombing, mail by air, even tourism would all completely change. This SCP will examine ways such a world might work.

Additional Notes: I've had this idea for a couple of years now, but I was never sure what to do with it. Recently, I remembered that there's a verse in the Quran that says:

"O assembly of jinns and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allah)!"

Essentially, the cause is that in our world, God has allowed humanity to leave the heavens and earth, but in SCP-X, God has not allowed this.

item.title: Seeking greenlight: Anomalous Impostor Syndrome
item.description: causes the person to conspire against themselves
item.content:encoded:
An anomalous version of Impostor Syndrome that causes the person to conspire against themselves.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Personal horror

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP article

Elevator Pitch: An anomalous variation of Impostor Syndrome in which the affected person believes they are an actual impostor, stealing their own memories and identity. Severe cases might end up in the subject trying to kill themselves in an attempt at returning things to their right way.

Central Narrative: An up-and-coming Foundation researcher starts to conspire against themself, to the point of hiring a hitman to kill themself. This catches the attention of the psychiatric department and an investigation begins.
After several therapy sessions the affected researcher is put through a brain scan and the anomaly is found: it is an auto immune response to the constant contact the reaearcher had had with memetic and antimemetic material. It caused their brain to stop recognizing their own memories.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
· An anomalous twist to an everyday problem, the Impostor Syndrome, a condition that causes a person to question their skills and value
· The concept of a memetic disease and a memetic immune system and how these interact with other memetic SCP articles and tales
· Potential long term characters and concepts to be used and explored by other articles and authors

Additional Notes: I haven't started writing it yet, this is the very first concept of my very first SCP article so I am open to all critics and suggestions :)

item.title: it's all in your head (seeking greenlight)
item.description: somewhat sentient parasite that controls the human mind
item.content:encoded:
a somewhat sentient parasite that controls the human mind and uses it to encourage others to get themselves infected

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Parasite enters the brain of a human and latches onto certain parts of it encouraging it or forcing it to meet its demands. The parasite spreads via bodily contact with its nesting spot or anybody infected. nesting spots are found within contaminated areas such as sewers, heavily polluted bodies of water. the parasite eventually makes its host practically braindead only able to meet the demands of its master, while the parasite uses the body as a vessel to transmit the parasite and as a food source. the parasite also uses any forms of mental illness and traumatic moments, fond memories, anything that it can find inside the host's mind to exploit.

the parasite uses the researcher to create a document on the parasite claiming that it's not dangerous and that it is beneficial. while writing it, however, consciousness snaps back and he realizes what he is writing and tries to correct it, but with the parasite still in control of his mind, he fails.

Central Narrative: I intend on creating an article that tries to encourage you that the parasite is completely harmless while subtlely explaining what it actually does, while its host tries to fight it off, to no avail

Hook/Attention-Grabber: the parasite is using humans as hosts to try to encourage others to get themselves infected, specifically via the article

Additional Notes: I would like as much critique as I can get.
